user.title: Reef Tank Tracker
user.description: Set up tracking for one reef aquarium. After setup you can configure habitat, problem, and inventory via Lovelace or services.

abort.already_configured: Reef Tank Tracker is already set up. It supports a single tank per HA instance.

sources.title: Auto-source sensors
sources.description: For each parameter, optionally pick a sensor whose value will be used as the 'latest' fallback when no manual reading is fresh. Defaults are pre-filled where we know about them (e.g. KH Keeper, ATO probe). Leave a row empty for manual / ICP-only parameters.

advisor.title: Alk dosing advisor
advisor.description: Configure the alkalinity dosing recommendation engine. Leave 'Enable advisor' off until your KH source is calibrated. The advisor reads daily snapshots of KH + the sum of programmed dose across the selected alk heads, then suggests a daily-dose change weekly. v1 is recommendation-only — never writes to your doser.
